positive: Sealed single item0001 original associated with exactly one /proc/self/mountinfo source_paths entry, correct source/attempt/run and SHA-256

Preserve unknown optional tags opaque; do not interpret mount propagation from tags not authorized by source contract

Wrong fixed source path, missing path, extra path, wrong item ordinal, forged receipt source/run identity or modified sealed bytes fail canonical
